claim_boundary: paired frozen-probe calibration measurement only; no causal, routing, utility, learning, adaptation, calibrated-belief, or general capability claim without manual review

conditions.base: six public evidence events plus D delay frames
conditions.delay_plus_two: same six evidence events plus D+2 delay frames
conditions.neutral_cue_plus_two: same six evidence events plus every two-symbol suffix at reliability 0.5, 0.5 plus D delay frames

primary_target: public-evidence log_odds computed from the original six evidence events; byte-identical across paired variants
fit_scope: fit on all train-family base rows only; reuse fixed coefficients, train standardization, and label-independent projection for heldout-order A/B/C evaluations
condition_normalized_sensitivity: separate label-free coordinate centering/scaling within train-base and each heldout condition; reported only as a predeclared sensitivity, never as frozen-calibration evidence
independent_unit: model seed; suffixes and projection settings are dependent sensitivity conditions
acceptance_criterion: for every seed, delay-equivalent condition, neutral suffix, and fixed projection sensitivity, frozen projected state must exceed every matched control; B failure indicates elapsed-time calibration failure, B pass/C failure indicates neutral-input invariance failure
falsifier: failure of the criterion in B or any C suffix; no causal channel intervention follows a failed gate
